sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_user_profiles" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guest', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_metadata" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "auth_uid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "providers" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "email" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "photo_url" TEXT NULL, "last_sign_in_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persons" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "birth_year_known" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("birth_year_known" IN (0, 1)), "gender" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "organization" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_categories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_category_relations" ("person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("person_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_types" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rules" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "freq" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "by_weekday" TEXT NULL, "by_month_day" INTEGER NULL, "by_month" INTEGER NULL, "by_set_pos" INTEGER NULL, "until_date" TEXT NULL, "count" INTEGER NULL, "overflow_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'clamp_to_last_day', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ("interval" >= 1), CHECK (NOT (until_date IS NOT NULL AND count IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "tz_id" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "color" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "recurrence_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurrence_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_person_relations" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_relationships" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "related_person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (related_person_id IS NULL OR related_person_id <> person_id), CHECK (relation_type <> 'custom' OR (custom_label IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(custom_label)) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_definitions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'person', "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_values" ("definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_field_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("definition_id", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_filters" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_exceptions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "original_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "override_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("event_id", "original_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commitment_types" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commitments" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitment_types (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "provider_name" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "expiry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "renewal_date" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "renewal_months" INTEGER NULL, "reference_number" TEXT NULL, "service_url" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "lifecycle_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (renewal_months IS NULL OR renewal_months >= 1), CHECK (amount_minor IS NULL OR amount_minor >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commitment_renewals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "commitment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commitments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "renewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "previous_expiry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "new_expiry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("owner_type", "owner_id", "offset_minutes"), CHECK (offset_minutes >= 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "color" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_tag_relations" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "memory_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_person_relations" ("memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("memory_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (due_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR due_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_person_relations" ("project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("project_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_event_relations" ("project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("project_id", "event_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "milestones" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "row_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_user_profiles (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "milestone_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_persons_full_name ON persons (full_name)
CREATE INDEX idx_persons_birth_date ON persons (birth_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_persons_deleted_at ON persons (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_pcr_category ON person_category_relations (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_start_date ON events (start_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_type ON events (event_type_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_deleted_at ON events (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_epr_person ON event_person_relations (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_rel_person ON person_relationships (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_rel_related ON person_relationships (related_person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_event_exceptions_event ON event_exceptions (event_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_commitments_expiry ON commitments (expiry_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_commitments_deleted_at ON commitments (deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_renewals_commitment ON commitment_renewals (commitment_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reminders_owner ON reminders (owner_type, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_entity_tags_entity ON entity_tag_relations (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_date ON memories (memory_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_mpr_person ON memory_person_relations (person_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_milestones_date ON milestones (milestone_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_owner ON attachments (owner_type, owner_id)
